item.title: 5C Regional Juvenile Detention Facility in St. Anthony to close
item.description: ST. ANTHONY — The Five County Detention and Youth Rehabilitation Center (5C) in St. Anthony will close, and more than 20 jobs will be lost. At a board meeting on Tuesday commissioners from Teton, Clark, Madison, Jefferson and Fremont counties voted 4–1 to close the detention center, with Clark County casting the lone dissenting vote.
